method.tool: Vercel MCP deploy_to_vercel (target=production, name=proklinator-static, teamId omitted)
method.description: build.mjs fetches the 73 site files (2825976 B) from raw.githubusercontent.com (fallback: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, 3 attempts per source on network errors / non-2xx / 30 s timeouts, 8 in flight; a hash or length mismatch is never retried on the same source) at the pinned commit 080a3a4 and aborts with exit 1 unless each file's byte length and SHA-256 match the values in `files` above, then writes them to ./public and re-checks that the output tree holds exactly the manifest (nothing missing, nothing extra, sizes exact, total exact). The deployment therefore contains exactly the repo bytes of the pinned commit; this is the same pattern as the v20 … v20.5 deploys. The manifest was generated from the pinned commit's git blobs (HEAD == origin/main == 080a3a4 after a fresh fetch and fast-forward, clean tree, every blob cross-checked against the working tree, 0 mismatches) and the script was dry-run locally before deploying with Node 22.14 (73/73 files fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com in 1.6 s and byte-identical to the checkout, output tree == manifest, no README / DEPLOY_RESULT / docs / tools / .gitignore in the output), together with a negative test (one tampered hash for app.js -> both sources rejected, the build aborts with exit 1 after 72/73) and a fallback test (raw host replaced by an unreachable name -> all 73 files come from cdn.jsdelivr.net in 37.7 s, still byte-identical). The Vercel build finished in under 2.5 minutes; the raw deployment URL served the verified v20.6 index at the first poll (12:26:44Z) and the public alias followed by 12:27:08Z.

notes: The task described the repository as private; gh reports visibility PUBLIC (isPrivate false), which is what makes the unauthenticated pinned-commit fetch in build.mjs possible. If the repo is ever made private, this deploy method needs a token or an inline file tree.

The local checkout booted at c32a5d1 (merge of PR #15, v20.5 record); origin/main was fetched first and fast-forwarded to 080a3a4 (merge of PR #16) before the manifest was generated, so the pinned SHA is the one named in the task.
Git-linked auto-deploy was not used, for the same reasons as before: create_git_project requires teamId (the 403 trigger) and cannot re-link the existing unlinked project proklinator-static.

teamId was omitted from deploy_to_vercel, as in the prior successful deploys; no 403 occurred. Team-scoped read endpoints (get_deployment_build_logs with the known team id returned 404 'Deployment not found' for this token) were not usable, so the build was followed and verified over HTTP against the raw deployment URL and the public alias.

The existing project proklinator-static was reused (protection already off); no new project was created and no auth/SSO/protection settings were touched. Registration and payments were not opened. Auth stays NO-GO.

README.md, DEPLOY_RESULT.json, docs/ (including the new docs/content punch-pack sources), .gitignore and tools/build_assets.py stay out of the deployment; ATTRIBUTIONS.md and assets/fx/LICENSE-kenney.txt stay in so the CC0 / ISC / OFL attributions travel with the served files.
The headless ritual smoke wrote only to the headless browser's own throwaway profile (localStorage gate record, one history entry); the site has no backend and nothing was sent anywhere.
No app code was changed for this deploy; this commit updates DEPLOY_RESULT.json only.
